sql.ricochetWebhook.getContactIdByRicochetLe: select contact_id from flow.contact_custom_field_value where text_value = :ricochetLeadId and custom_field_group_assignment_id = 398 and archived is false limit 1
sql.ricochetWebhook.getContactIdByContactInf: select id contact_id from flow.contact where first_name = :firstName and last_name = :lastName and mobile = :mobile and email = :email and street1 = :street1 and city = :city and postal_code = :postalCode and company_state_id = :companyStateId::integer and archived is false limit 1
sql.ricochetWebhook.getUserIdByLeadOwnerEmai: select id user_id from flow.user where lower(email) = lower(:leadOwnerEmail) limit 1
sql.ricochetWebhook.getUserPositionIdByUserI: select id user_position_id from flow.user_position where user_id = :leadOwnerUserId and primary_flag is true and archived is not true limit 1
sql.ricochetWebhook.getStateAbbreviationBySt: select abbreviation state_abbreviation from flow.state where state = :stateName
sql.ricochetWebhook.getCompanyStateIdByState: select cs.id company_state_id from flow.company_state cs inner join flow.state s on s.id = cs.state_id where s.abbreviation = :stateAbbreviation::character varying and cs.company_id = 3
sql.ricochetWebhook.getCompanyCountryIdByCom: select cc.id company_country_id from flow.company_country cc where cc.company_id = 3
sql.ricochetWebhook.updateLead: update flow.contact set first_name = :firstName, last_name = :lastName, mobile = :mobile, email = :email, street1 = :street1, city = :city, postal_code = :postalCode, company_state_id = :companyStateId::integer, date_modified = now(), modified_by_id = :leadOwnerUserId, owner_user_position_id = :leadOwnerUserPositionId, company_country_id = :companyCountryId::integer where id = :contactId returning id
sql.ricochetWebhook.checkIfCustomFieldDropdo: select id from flow.list_of_value lov where lov.parent_id = :listOfValueId and lov.name = :customFieldDropdownValue
sql.ricochetWebhook.insertCustomFieldDropdow: with display_order as ( select max(display_order) as value from flow.list_of_value where parent_id = :listOfValueId ) insert into flow.list_of_value (name, parent_id, display_order, created_by_id) (select :customFieldDropdownValue, :listOfValueId, ((select value from display_order) + 1), :leadOwnerUserId) returning id
sql.ricochetWebhook.upsertCustomFieldValue: insert into flow.contact_custom_field_value (contact_id, custom_field_group_assignment_id, text_value, int_value, created_by_id) values (:contactId, :customFieldGroupAssignmentId, :textValue, :intValue, :leadOwnerUserId) on conflict (contact_id, custom_field_group_assignment_id) do update set text_value = :textValue, int_value = :intValue, modified_by_id = :leadOwnerUserId, date_modified = now()
